reader_summary.overview: Today's discussion with Kim Lew, President and CEO of the Columbia Investment Management Company. Kim shares her insights on navigating the intricate world of investment management, particularly in risk management and asset allocation. With a career marked by pivotal roles at entities like the Ford Foundation and Carnegie Corporation.
